notes: Typical daytime appliance use with one washer cycle, one dryer cycle, and ordinary fridge openings.
Single late-night fridge use should not become an alert by itself.
Four fridge checks in ten minutes during daytime should be treated as borderline/attention, not automatically high risk.
Three air purifier mode changes before night should expose whether sustained attention is too eager to escalate.
Night fridge rechecking with short-window burst and 30-minute support should be risk.
Dawn air purifier mode loop should be risk because baseline has no normal examples and time context is high risk.
Washer restart after done at night should be risk and excluded from baseline learning.
Raw HA-like CSV with telemetry/noise mixed in; mapper should keep behavior rows and skip telemetry.
